result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few elements appear clipped or obscured, mainly around horizontally scrolling content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content appear cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal carousel in the “Fastest near you” section cuts off the third restaurant card and its text at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have appropriate spacing and consider adding a visual scroll hint or snapping behavior so partially visible cards feel intentional.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially visible empty/next chip at the far right edge, which looks like a clipped UI element.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding or scroll positioning so partial chips appear intentional, or avoid showing an unlabeled sliver at the edge.
